Presenting this well-maintained studio apartment in Torino by ORO24, Arjan, offering a smart layout and peaceful garden views.

Property Details:
• Studio Apartment
• Size: 366 Sqft
• Garden View
• Semi-Furnished (with Kitchen Appliances)
• Vacant – Ready to Move In

This unit features a bright living space, modern finishing, and a functional kitchen equipped with essential appliances. The garden-facing view provides a calm and relaxing environment, ideal for end-users or tenants looking for comfort and convenience.

Torino by ORO24 is a contemporary development in Arjan, offering quality amenities such as swimming pool, gym, landscaped areas, and recreational facilities, with easy access to major roads and nearby attractions.

Asking Rent: AED 60,000

For more details or to arrange a viewing, feel free to get in touch.
